articles.title: Okta buys AI security startup Permiso; source says for about $200M
articles.titleEn: Okta buys AI security startup Permiso; source says for about $200M
articles.titleKo: Okta, AI 보안 스타트업 Permiso 인수 소식통에 따르면 약 2억 달러에 달한다고 함
articles.summary:
Okta on Thursday agreed to acquire AI identity security startup Permiso Security , betting that demand for protecting AI agents and other machine identities will grow as enterprises deploy autonomous software across their operations.
More recently, the startup has expanded its platform to monitor AI agents and other machine identities.
Permiso, which emerged from stealth in 2022 , develops software that helps security teams spot suspicious activity in cloud environments after users or applications have been granted access.
summaryLinesEn: Okta on Thursday agreed to acquire AI identity security startup Permiso Security , betting that demand for protecting AI agents and other machine identities will grow as enterprises deploy autonomous software across their operations.
More recently, the startup has expanded its platform to monitor AI agents and other machine identities.
Permiso, which emerged from stealth in 2022 , develops software that helps security teams spot suspicious activity in cloud environments after users or applications have been granted access.
summaryLinesKo: 옥타(Okta)는 목요일 AI 신원 보안 스타트업 퍼미소 시큐리티(Permiso Security)를 인수하기로 합의했으며, 기업이 운영 전반에 자율 소프트웨어를 배치함에 따라 AI 에이전트 및 기타 기계 신원 보호에 대한 수요가 증가할 것이라고 확신함
최근 이 스타트업은 AI 에이전트 및 기타 기계 ID를 모니터링하기 위해 플랫폼을 확장함
2022년 스텔스에서 등장한 Permiso는 사용자 또는 애플리케이션에 액세스 권한이 부여된 후 보안 팀이 클라우드 환경에서 의심스러운 활동을 발견하는 데 도움이 되는 소프트웨어를 개발함

articles.title: Forward-deployed engineers are the AI industry’s latest talent obsession
articles.titleEn: Forward-deployed engineers are the AI industry’s latest talent obsession
articles.titleKo: 전진 배치된 엔지니어는 AI 업계의 최신 인재 집착임
articles.summary:
“Not 2,000 available,” reads the study, shared exclusively with TechCrunch. “2,000 total.”
By the end of the second quarter, however, that number jumped to 70%, with the largest consulting and services firms reporting a need to increase their FDE headcount by 10 times, building full teams of 20 to 100 employees.
Executive search firm Christian & Timbers estimates that there are only about 2,000 engineers in the U.S. with the special cocktail of sector know-how, gravitas, and hands-on applied AI experience needed to consistently help enterprises see a return on their AI expenditures.

Executive search firm Christian & Timbers estimates that there are only about 2,000 engineers in the U.S. with the special cocktail of sector know-how, gravitas, and hands-on applied AI experience needed to consistently help enterprises see a return on their AI expenditures.
summaryLinesKo: TechCrunch와 독점적으로 공유된 연구 결과는 "2,000개가 없음" · 라고 읽음 · “총 2,000개요”
그러나 2분기 말에는 그 수치가 70%로 급증했으며, 최대 규모의 컨설팅 및 서비스 기업에서는 FDE 인원을 10배 늘려 20~100명의 직원으로 구성된 전체 팀을 구성해야 한다고 보고함
전문 검색 회사인 Christian & Timbers는 기업이 AI 지출에 대한 수익을 지속적으로 얻을 수 있도록 지원하는 데 필요한 부문별 노하우, 중력 및 실무 응용 AI 경험을 혼합한 특별한 칵테일을 갖춘 미국 내 엔지니어가 약 2,000명에 불과하다고 추정함

articles.title: LinkedIn Won’t Be Expanding Its Data Centers in the Next Year
articles.titleEn: LinkedIn Won’t Be Expanding Its Data Centers in the Next Year
articles.titleKo: LinkedIn은 내년에 데이터 센터를 확장하지 않을 것임
articles.summary:
The spending calculations apply to LinkedIn’s fiscal year that began last month and ends next June.
LinkedIn moved to optimize its data center usage at every stage of the AI pipeline, from training models to serving them in response to user queries.
Altogether, LinkedIn estimates its efficiency work has saved about $24 million over the past 12 months, or the equivalent of roughly 1,100 GPUs running around the clock for a year.

summaryLinesKo: 지출 계산은 지난 달에 시작되어 내년 6월에 끝나는 LinkedIn의 회계연도에 적용됨
LinkedIn은 모델 교육부터 사용자 쿼리에 대한 응답까지 AI 파이프라인의 모든 단계에서 데이터 센터 사용을 최적화하기 위해 노력함
전체적으로 LinkedIn은 효율성 작업을 통해 지난 12개월 동안 약 2,400만 달러를 절약했다고 추정함 · 이는 1년 동안 24시간 내내 작동하는 GPU 약 1,100개에 해당하는 금액임

articles.title: OpenAI claims GPT-5.6 Sol beats Opus 5 on ARC-AGI-3 with its latest API and two additional settings
articles.titleEn: OpenAI claims GPT-5.6 Sol beats Opus 5 on ARC-AGI-3 with its latest API and two additional settings
articles.titleKo: OpenAI는 GPT-5.6 Sol이 최신 API와 두 가지 추가 설정을 통해 ARC-AGI-3에서 Opus 5를 능가한다고 주장함
articles.summary:
After Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 quadrupled the record score on the logic benchmark , OpenAI is now showing that GPT-5.6 Sol hits 38.3 percent with two API settings, beating Opus 5's 30.2 percent.
In the official harness, GPT-5.6 Sol scored just 7.8 percent because the model's reasoning gets discarded after each action.
Different providers using different settings does create "a potential parity issue," Chollet said, but he considers that acceptable "as long as the settings and the cost are clearly reported."
summaryLinesEn: After Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 quadrupled the record score on the logic benchmark , OpenAI is now showing that GPT-5.6 Sol hits 38.3 percent with two API settings, beating Opus 5's 30.2 percent.
In the official harness, GPT-5.6 Sol scored just 7.8 percent because the model's reasoning gets discarded after each action.
Different providers using different settings does create "a potential parity issue," Chollet said, but he considers that acceptable "as long as the settings and the cost are clearly reported."
summaryLinesKo: Anthropic의 Claude Opus 5가 로직 벤치마크에서 기록 점수를 4배로 늘린 후, OpenAI는 이제 GPT-5.6 Sol이 두 가지 API 설정으로 38.3%를 기록하여 Opus 5의 30.2%를 제치고 있음을 보여주고 있음
공식 하네스에서 GPT-5.6 Sol은 각 조치 후에 모델의 추론이 폐기되기 때문에 7.8%의 점수를 얻었음
서로 다른 설정을 사용하는 여러 제공업체는 "잠재적인 동등성 문제"를 야기하지만 "설정과 비용이 명확하게 보고되는 한" 허용 가능하다고 생각함

articles.title: AI Scammers Are Better at Building Trust Than Humans
articles.titleEn: AI Scammers Are Better at Building Trust Than Humans
articles.titleKo: AI 사기꾼은 인간보다 신뢰 구축에 더 능숙함
articles.summary:
In their study, the researchers pitted AI chatbots directly against humans in a simulation of the scamming process—or more specifically, the long, trust-building conversations that eventually lead up to soliciting a fake investment from the scam’s target.
The study's results suggest, nonetheless, that the scam industry may soon shift to more AI automation, says Erin West, a former Santa Clara County, California, prosecutor who now leads an anti-scam organization called Operation Shamrock.
(The term “pig butchering” itself describes the same system but with the metaphor of fattening “pigs” by building trust before “butchering” them with the investment fraud—though the term is often discouraged due to its pejorative reference to victims.)
summaryLinesEn: In their study, the researchers pitted AI chatbots directly against humans in a simulation of the scamming process—or more specifically, the long, trust-building conversations that eventually lead up to soliciting a fake investment from the scam’s target.

The study's results suggest, nonetheless, that the scam industry may soon shift to more AI automation, says Erin West, a former Santa Clara County, California, prosecutor who now leads an anti-scam organization called Operation Shamrock.

(The term “pig butchering” itself describes the same system but with the metaphor of fattening “pigs” by building trust before “butchering” them with the investment fraud—though the term is often discouraged due to its pejorative reference to victims.)
summaryLinesKo: 연구에서 연구원들은 사기 과정, 더 구체적으로 사기 대상으로부터 가짜 투자를 유도하는 길고 신뢰를 쌓는 대화를 시뮬레이션하면서 AI 챗봇을 인간과 직접 비교함
그럼에도 불구하고 연구 결과는 사기 업계가 곧 더 많은 AI 자동화로 전환할 수 있음을 시사한다고 전직 캘리포니아 주 산타클라라 카운티 검사이자 현재 Operation Shamrock이라는 사기 방지 조직을 이끌고 있는 Erin West는 말함
('돼지 도살'이라는 용어 자체는 동일한 시스템을 설명하지만 투자 사기로 '돼지'를 '도살'하기 전에 신뢰를 구축하여 '돼지'를 살찌운다는 비유를 사용함 · 이 용어는 피해자를 경멸적으로 언급하기 때문에 종종 사용되지 않습니다.)

articles.title: Dili raises $21.7M to bring AI compliance to the infrastructure boom
articles.titleEn: Dili raises $21.7M to bring AI compliance to the infrastructure boom
articles.titleKo: Dili는 인프라 붐에 AI 규정 준수를 도입하기 위해 2,170만 달러를 모금함
articles.summary:
On Thursday, a new AI compliance company called Dili that squarely targets the new crop of U.S. infrastructure projects, said it had raised $15 million in Series A funding.
Dili is able to handle both types of contract, although Chaturvedi anticipates the industry will shift more towards the software model in the years to come.
But all those infrastructure projects may also need a bit of help from AI.

articles.title: Nscale buys Anyscale as it seeks to own more of the AI compute stack
articles.titleEn: Nscale buys Anyscale as it seeks to own more of the AI compute stack
articles.titleKo: Nscale은 AI 컴퓨팅 스택을 더 많이 소유하기 위해 Anyscale을 인수함
articles.summary:
Nscale is paying $1.65 billion for Anyscale, Bloomberg reported , citing an anonymous source.
In a bid to capture more of its customers’ AI spending, British AI neocloud Nscale is buying software startup Anyscale , which helps companies scale their AI workloads across data centers and servers.
Anyscale, which was valued at $1.38 billion in a 2022 Series C round , said its revenue increased by 70% in its most recent quarter, compared to the previous sequential quarter.

영국의 AI 네오클라우드 Nscale은 고객의 AI 지출을 더 많이 확보하기 위해 기업이 데이터 센터와 서버 전반에 걸쳐 AI 워크로드를 확장하는 데 도움이 되는 소프트웨어 스타트업 Anyscale을 인수하고 있음

articles.titleEn: Google’s Gemini Can Now Stomp Around as a Humanoid Robot

articles.summary:
“There's a lot of uncertainty that will show up, and so you want to be able to understand the safety question more deeply.”
“It's another milestone in our path towards really getting towards what we call like physical AGI, which means we get a robot to do anything that a human can,” Carolina Parada, head of robotics at Google DeepMind, tells WIRED.
Google DeepMind just released a new version of its artificial intelligence model Gemini , and it can control a range of different robots—including humanoids capable of dextrous tasks like screwing in lightbulbs and tying trash bags.

articles.title: ChatGPT and Roblox will reportedly be subject to tighter rules in the EU - Engadget
articles.titleEn: ChatGPT and Roblox will reportedly be subject to tighter rules in the EU - Engadget
articles.titleKo: ChatGPT와 Roblox는 EU에서 더 엄격한 규칙을 적용받을 것으로 알려졌습니다 - Engadget
articles.summary:
The European Union is gearing up to label ChatGPT and Roblox as "very large online platforms," according to Bloomberg .
While it does mean that they're widely used in the block, it also subjects them to stricter rules and gives them more requirements to comply with.
Under the EU's Digital Services Act (DSA), platforms and search engines with more than 45 million users a month in the region are given the designation.

이는 블록에서 널리 사용된다는 것을 의미하지만 더 엄격한 규칙을 적용하고 준수해야 할 더 많은 요구 사항을 제공함

articles.summary:
If the US economy keeps relying on foreign sources, it subjects itself to "the whims of foreign entities that could disrupt or degrade the supply chains at a time of their choosing," the document states.
Robots are inherently networked systems with large attack surfaces that enable data exfiltration, remote control, and insecure over-the-air updates, according to the document.
The Trump administration has used the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to ban imports of new foreign "advanced robotic devices" and internet-connected Chinese power inverters.

articles.titleKo: LinkedIn은 'AI 슬롭처럼 보이는' 보고 도구를 테스트하고 있습니다 - Engadget
articles.summary:
A recent study from AI detection company Pangram found that LinkedIn "was the most AI-saturated" social media platform with more than 40 percent of longform posts "flagged as fully AI-generated."
It's removing the built-in AI writing tools that allowed users to "enhance" their posts and messages with the help of LLMs.

articles.title: Field service is 95% on board with AI but these legacy issues need attention
articles.titleEn: Field service is 95% on board with AI but these legacy issues need attention
articles.titleKo: 현장 서비스에는 AI가 95% 포함되어 있지만 이러한 레거시 문제에 주의가 필요함
articles.summary:
Almost all (95%) field service organizations now use AI , and 85% plan to increase investments over the next two years, according to Salesforce's State of Field Service research, a survey of over 2,300 field service professionals across nine countries.
The top business goals for AI adoption in field service are increasing customer satisfaction (35%), improving mobile worker productivity (31%), improving safety outcomes (27%), shifting from reactive to proactive and predictive maintenance (26%), and increasing revenues (25%).
Field service organizations are also seeing increased revenue from field operations (39%), possibly due to faster response times for customers (39%).

articles.titleKo: OpenAI는 가장 저렴한 GPT-5.6 모델을 80% 인하하여 중국 전체 가격 모드를 진행함
articles.summary:
OpenAI is cutting GPT-5.6 Luna prices by 80 percent and Terra by 20 percent, effective July 30.
OpenAI says the cuts are possible because GPT-5.6 Sol made the company's own infrastructure more efficient .
Luna drops to $0.20 per million input tokens and $1.20 per million output tokens, while Terra falls to $2 and $12.

Luna는 입력 토큰 1백만 달러당 0.20달러, 출력 토큰 1백만 달러당 1.20달러로 하락하고, Terra는 2달러와 12달러로 하락함

articles.title: Google DeepMind’s new AI model can control a robot’s entire body
articles.titleEn: Google DeepMind’s new AI model can control a robot’s entire body
articles.titleKo: Google DeepMind의 새로운 AI 모델은 로봇의 몸 전체를 제어할 수 있음
articles.summary:
Videos shared by Google show how Apptronik’s Apollo 2 robot can bend over to pick up a watering can, as well as find and take specific items off a shelf.
While the previous model focused on controlling a humanoid robot’s upper body, Gemini Robotics 2 now supports “whole-body motions” ranging from its feet to fingertips, according to an announcement on Thursday .
Though Google DeepMind notes that its robots “have more to advance in movement speed,” it adds that this update “is an important step towards the skills needed to complete more complex, real-world tasks that require whole-body coordination.”
summaryLinesEn: Videos shared by Google show how Apptronik’s Apollo 2 robot can bend over to pick up a watering can, as well as find and take specific items off a shelf.

While the previous model focused on controlling a humanoid robot’s upper body, Gemini Robotics 2 now supports “whole-body motions” ranging from its feet to fingertips, according to an announcement on Thursday .

Though Google DeepMind notes that its robots “have more to advance in movement speed,” it adds that this update “is an important step towards the skills needed to complete more complex, real-world tasks that require whole-body coordination.”
summaryLinesKo: Google에서 공유한 동영상에서는 Apptronik의 Apollo 2 로봇이 몸을 굽혀 물뿌리개를 집어 들고 선반에서 특정 품목을 찾아 꺼내는 방법을 보여줍니
이전 모델이 휴머노이드 로봇의 상체 제어에 중점을 두었다면 제미니 로보틱스 2(Gemini Robotics 2)는 이제 발부터 손가락 끝까지 '전신 모션'을 지원한다고 목요일 발표됨
Google DeepMind는 로봇이 "이동 속도에서 더 발전해야 한다"고 언급했지만 이번 업데이트는 "전신 조정이 필요한 보다 복잡하고 실제 작업을 완료하는 데 필요한 기술을 향한 중요한 단계"라고 덧붙였음

articles.title: LinkedIn actually adds a ‘seems like AI slop’ button
articles.titleEn: LinkedIn actually adds a ‘seems like AI slop’ button
articles.titleKo: LinkedIn은 실제로 'AI 슬롭처럼 보이는' 버튼을 추가함
articles.summary:
AI detector Pangram recently found that 41 percent of longform LinkedIn posts were flagged as being completely generated by AI, as reported by 404Media .
The new button will help LinkedIn “tune our models and make better feeds,” Srinivasan says.
In addition to the button to report a post as seemingly being AI-generated, LinkedIn is also ramping up new classifiers to identify “if a post is AI-slop or generally low-quality content,” which will “reduce the amount of AI slop you might see in suggested content and content from outside your network.”
summaryLinesEn: AI detector Pangram recently found that 41 percent of longform LinkedIn posts were flagged as being completely generated by AI, as reported by 404Media .
The new button will help LinkedIn “tune our models and make better feeds,” Srinivasan says.

In addition to the button to report a post as seemingly being AI-generated, LinkedIn is also ramping up new classifiers to identify “if a post is AI-slop or generally low-quality content,” which will “reduce the amount of AI slop you might see in suggested content and content from outside your network.”
summaryLinesKo: AI 탐지기 Pangram은 최근 404Media에서 보고한 바와 같이 장문의 LinkedIn 게시물 중 41%가 AI에 의해 완전히 생성된 것으로 표시되었음을 발견함
새로운 버튼은 LinkedIn이 "모델을 조정하고 더 나은 피드를 만드는 데" 도움이 될 것이라고 Srinivasan은 말함
게시물을 AI로 생성된 것으로 보고하는 버튼 외에도 LinkedIn은 "게시물이 AI 슬롭인지 또는 일반적으로 품질이 낮은 콘텐츠인지" 식별하기 위해 새로운 분류기를 강화하고 있음 · 이를 통해 "추천 콘텐츠와 네트워크 외부의 콘텐츠에서 볼 수 있는 AI 슬롭의 양이 줄어듭니"

articles.title: LinkedIn adds a button to report AI-generated 'slop'
articles.titleEn: LinkedIn adds a button to report AI-generated 'slop'
articles.titleKo: LinkedIn에 AI 생성 '슬롭'을 보고하는 버튼 추가
articles.summary:
People come to LinkedIn to connect with real people and share their real perspectives, ideas, and expertise,” he said.
The move reflects a broader shift across online publishing platforms to cut back on AI content, as people have grown frustrated with the computer-written, inauthentic posts filling the web.
Plus, LinkedIn will begin privately flagging in users’ dashboards when people believe their content is coming off as inauthentic due to heavy use of AI.
summaryLinesEn: People come to LinkedIn to connect with real people and share their real perspectives, ideas, and expertise,” he said.
The move reflects a broader shift across online publishing platforms to cut back on AI content, as people have grown frustrated with the computer-written, inauthentic posts filling the web.
Plus, LinkedIn will begin privately flagging in users’ dashboards when people believe their content is coming off as inauthentic due to heavy use of AI.
summaryLinesKo: 사람들은 실제 사람들과 연결하고 실제 관점, 아이디어 및 전문 지식을 공유하기 위해 LinkedIn을 방문함” · 라고 그는 말함
이러한 움직임은 사람들이 컴퓨터로 작성된 허위 게시물이 웹을 가득 채우는 것에 대한 불만이 커짐에 따라 AI 콘텐츠를 줄이기 위한 온라인 게시 플랫폼 전반의 광범위한 변화를 반영함

articles.title: Google says it fixed more Chrome bugs in June than over the past two years, thanks to AI
articles.titleEn: Google says it fixed more Chrome bugs in June than over the past two years, thanks to AI
articles.titleKo: 구글은 AI 덕분에 지난 2년보다 6월에 더 많은 크롬 버그를 수정했다고 밝힘
articles.summary:
A chart published by Google, which the company revealed as part of a white paper on the company’s efforts to use AI to find flaws and patch them faster, shows the exponential increase.
Doug Turner, Chrome’s director of engineering, told TechCrunch in a statement that LLMs have “fundamentally shifted the economics of cybersecurity, transforming vulnerability discovery into an automated, industrial-scale operation.”
With help from its internal AI tools, Google says it has patched more security flaws in its Chrome browser in the last month than in the past two years combined.

articles.title: Companies are finally seeing AI ROI — and now they know how much more value it can deliver
articles.titleEn: Companies are finally seeing AI ROI — and now they know how much more value it can deliver
articles.titleKo: 기업은 마침내 AI ROI를 확인하고 있으며 이제 AI가 얼마나 더 많은 가치를 제공할 수 있는지 알고 있음
articles.summary:
In fact, general AI ROI went from 16% to 21% this year, and should grow to $15.9m in two years’ time, even as only 3% say they are fully prepared for it.
Enterprise AI has moved from experiment to execution, and that shift is beginning to show real returns.
The SAP Value of AI Report 2026, produced with Oxford Economics and based on a survey of 2,600 business leaders across 13 countries, found that AI now supports nearly one-third of all tasks in the average organization, rising to 30% from 25% last year.

summaryLinesKo: 실제로 일반 AI ROI는 올해 16%에서 21%로 증가했으며 2년 안에 1,590만 달러로 증가할 것임 · 단 3%만이 완전히 준비되어 있다고 응답함
엔터프라이즈 AI는 실험에서 실행으로 옮겨갔고, 그 변화가 실제 수익을 보여주기 시작함
Oxford Economics와 함께 작성하고 13개국 2,600명의 비즈니스 리더를 대상으로 한 설문조사를 기반으로 작성된 SAP AI 가치 보고서 2026에서는 AI가 현재 일반 조직의 모든 작업 중 거의 1/3을 지원하는 것으로 나타남 · 이는 지난해 25%에서 30%로 증가한 수치임

articles.title: China’s open-weight model lead exposes America’s AI blind spot
articles.titleEn: China’s open-weight model lead exposes America’s AI blind spot
articles.titleKo: 중국의 오픈 웨이트 모델 리드가 미국의 AI 사각지대를 폭로하
articles.summary:
Microsoft beats Q4 cloud expectations as full-year Azure revenue tops $100 billion Meta's Reality Labs lost over $4.6 billion in second quarter Meta posts earnings miss, issues light revenue guidance Tim Cook's last earnings call comes at momentous time for Apple with stock at record America has restricted China's access to advanced chips, spent billions to onshore semiconductor manufacturing and encouraged a massive buildout of data centers and power.
Some of America’s biggest technology companies are urging Washington to support the open-weight movement.
China’s growing lead is adding urgency and raising the risk that American companies become dependent on Chinese technology.

Some of America’s biggest technology companies are urging Washington to support the open-weight movement.

articles.titleEn: Disney is ditching Microsoft's GitHub Copilot and adding OpenAI's Codex
articles.titleKo: 디즈니는 마이크로소프트의 GitHub Copilot을 버리고 OpenAI의 Codex를 추가하고 있음
articles.summary:
A breakup with Disney is the latest headache for Microsoft's Copilot, which "lags behind" rivals like ChatGPT and Claude in adoption, as Business Insider's Ashley Stewart has reported.
The company said GitHub Copilot's request-based model was "no longer sustainable" as it unveiled the shift.
Microsoft has set out to revamp GitHub while shaking up its Copilot teams to help its many Copilot tools compete with rivals from OpenAI and Anthropic.

He also fleshed out how Meta could expand beyond serving the small business customer that makes up much of its current advertiser base by offering Meta’s internal tools to external customers in the future.
This shift in focus may not come easy — Zuckerberg admitted that selling to the enterprise was a “different muscle” than the one Meta has historically flexed.
Meanwhile, in terms of Meta selling compute to enterprise customers, Meta is focused on balancing its need for revenue and its need to execute on its own future plans.

articles.title: It’s Frighteningly Easy to Jailbreak Some Frontier AI Models
articles.titleEn: It’s Frighteningly Easy to Jailbreak Some Frontier AI Models
articles.titleKo: 일부 프론티어 AI 모델을 탈옥하는 것은 놀라울 정도로 쉽음
articles.summary:
The results are dirt cheap, all things considered—$58 to jailbreak Grok and $278 to jailbreak Gemini.
The tide might be shifting—a recent executive order calls for collaboration between the government and the private sector on related cybersecurity initiatives, and the president has hinted that light-touch regulations are in the works.
However, that doesn’t mean those models are immune to more sophisticated jailbreaks, which may involve interacting with a model in more complex ways, according to FAR.AI and other experts.

summaryLinesKo: Grok을 탈옥하는 데 58달러, Gemini를 탈옥하는 데 278달러 등 모든 것을 고려하면 결과는 매우 저렴함
흐름이 바뀔 수도 있음 · 최근 행정 명령은 관련 사이버 보안 계획에 대해 정부와 민간 부문 간의 협력을 요구하고 있으며, 대통령은 가벼운 규제가 진행 중임을 암시함
그러나 FAR.AI와 다른 전문가에 따르면, 이것이 해당 모델이 더 복잡한 방식으로 모델과 상호 작용하는 더 정교한 탈옥에 면역된다는 의미는 아님

articles.title: More Typos, Fewer Em Dashes: Writers Are Creating an Anti-AI ‘Literary Counterculture’
articles.titleEn: More Typos, Fewer Em Dashes: Writers Are Creating an Anti-AI ‘Literary Counterculture’
articles.titleKo: 더 많은 오타, 더 적은 엠 대시 · 작가들은 AI에 반대하는 '문학적 반문화'를 만들고 있음
articles.summary:
Since the widespread adoption of LLMs, Robson says her writing has fundamentally changed for the better, becoming a deliberate inverse of what she sees as AI’s default lack of style.
“It seems to me that literary fiction will shift even further in the direction of the weird, the esoteric, while personalization takes hold of commercial fiction.”
“Having my writing feel more real and authentic is my number one priority,” she says, in addition to editing her own writing because she claims an editor she hired ran the book through AI software.

summaryLinesKo: LLM이 널리 채택된 이후 Robson은 자신의 글이 근본적으로 더 나은 방향으로 바뀌었고 AI의 기본 스타일 부족이라고 생각하는 것과 의도적으로 반대가 되었다고 말함
“내 생각에는 문학 소설이 이상하고 난해한 방향으로 훨씬 더 많이 이동하는 반면, 개인화는 상업 소설을 장악할 것 같음”
그녀는 자신이 고용한 편집자가 AI 소프트웨어를 통해 책을 운영했다고 주장하기 때문에 자신의 글을 편집하는 것 외에도 "내 글이 더 현실적이고 진정성 있게 느껴지도록 하는 것이 최우선 과제임" · 라고 말함

articles.titleKo: 마사 스튜어트(Martha Stewart)가 공동 창업한 새로운 AI 스타트업 힌트(Hint)는 주택 소유자를 위한 AI 도우미를 제공함
articles.summary:
In addition, homeowners can use Hint to add one-off tasks to their maintenance plans — like a reminder to replace a damaged window screen or re-caulk some baseboards, or anything else that comes up.
Hint (whose name combines the “H” from “home” with “intelligence”) is backed by $10 million in funding from investors, including Montauk Capital, Brian Kelly (The Points Guy), Slow Ventures, Tusk Venture Partners, Energy Impact Partners, Amplo VC, and Hannah Grey.
Ahead of founding Hint, Rush led engineering at mattress startup Casper during its growth phase and was CTO at online retailer Maisonette.

articles.title: Encore AI raises $30M to build AI agents that learn from customer calls
articles.titleEn: Encore AI raises $30M to build AI agents that learn from customer calls
articles.titleKo: Encore AI는 고객 통화에서 학습하는 AI 에이전트를 구축하기 위해 3천만 달러를 모금함
articles.summary:
He said Encore’s annual recurring revenue has increased more than 5x since it raised its seed round less than 18 months ago, though he declined to disclose exact revenue numbers or valuation.
Now rebranded as Encore AI, the startup has expanded that system into a platform that analyzes conversations between a company’s employees and customers to identify which approaches resulted in successful outcomes, and uses those findings to train its AI agents.
Encore AI , a startup that studies companies’ customer interactions to train and deploy AI voice agents that can work alongside customer support and sales teams, or operate autonomously, has raised $30 million in a Series A round led by Team8.

articles.title: OpenAI admits its autonomous AI models also compromised credentials on other platforms during security eval
articles.titleEn: OpenAI admits its autonomous AI models also compromised credentials on other platforms during security eval
articles.titleKo: OpenAI는 자사의 자율 AI 모델이 보안 평가 중에 다른 플랫폼의 자격 증명도 손상했음을 인정함
articles.summary:
Those actions fell into around 6,280 clusters.
It then moved into the server cluster, internal cloud configurations, the internal network, and finally the software development systems.
OpenAI says none of these involved platform-level or account-level compromise and that it found no "evidence of broader impact to these providers or other accounts on their services."

articles.title: GPT Transcribe improves on its predecessor but can't catch ElevenLabs, Google, or Mistral on error rates
articles.titleEn: GPT Transcribe improves on its predecessor but can't catch ElevenLabs, Google, or Mistral on error rates
articles.titleKo: GPT Transcribe는 이전 버전보다 개선되었지만 ElevenLabs, Google 또는 Mistral의 오류율을 포착할 수 없음
articles.summary:
ElevenLabs Scribe v2 leads with a 2.3 percent error rate, followed by Google's Gemini 3 Pro at 2.9 percent and Mistral's Voxtral Small at 3 percent.
According to Artificial Analysis, which runs the AA-WER benchmark, GPT Transcribe hits a word error rate of 3.31 percent.
Pricing drops 25 percent at the same time, landing at $0.0045 per minute of audio.

articles.title: Boomers Can’t Stop Gifting Their Grandkids AI-Generated Slop Books
articles.titleEn: Boomers Can’t Stop Gifting Their Grandkids AI-Generated Slop Books
articles.titleKo: 붐 세대는 손자에게 AI로 생성된 슬롭북을 선물하는 것을 멈출 수 없음
articles.summary:
Another father, 40, in Los Angeles, says his mother-in-law has gifted his daughter and son, aged 1 and 3, respectively, a total of four slop books, including a pair of Mother’s Day–themed stories that are “exactly the same” apart from which kid is featured.
Xu says her research shows that the technical shortcomings of AI-generated children’s books (spelling mistakes, incoherent narratives, mismatches between images and text) mean they “struggle to deliver the qualities that make them both educationally valuable and entertaining.”
The former offers a $14.99 monthly plan that allows the generation of up to 20 stories per month, including “full audio narration” and an online story gallery; the latter has a $24 monthly premium plan with enough credits to create 50 books a month, with one printed book delivered in that period.

articles.title: Google will let Mac users talk to Gemini simply by pressing the 'fn' key - Engadget
articles.titleEn: Google will let Mac users talk to Gemini simply by pressing the 'fn' key - Engadget
articles.titleKo: Google은 Mac 사용자가 'fn' 키를 누르기만 하면 Gemini와 대화할 수 있게 함
articles.summary:
Google launched its native Gemini app for macOS in April, a day after it released the native Windows app.
While it only supports English for now, the company says support for more languages is coming later this year.
Starting today, Gemini users on Mac will be able to talk to the AI chatbot from any window on their computer simply by long-pressing the "fn" button on the bottom left corner of their keyboard.

articles.title: Google shuts down its Nobel-prize winning AlphaFold project as it focuses on Gemini - Engadget
articles.titleEn: Google shuts down its Nobel-prize winning AlphaFold project as it focuses on Gemini - Engadget
articles.titleKo: Google, Gemini에 초점을 맞추다 노벨상 수상 AlphaFold 프로젝트 종료 - Engadget
articles.summary:
In 2024, DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis and John Jumper, who was a staff research scientist when the project began and who eventually became a VP and engineering fellow, won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their work on AlphaFold.
DeepMind then launched the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database , giving researchers free access to over 200 million protein structure predictions.
"Our strategy over the last nine years has been to focus on grand challenges... a concrete goal every project is focused on," said Pushmeet Kohli, the VP of research at Google DeepMind.
summaryLinesEn: In 2024, DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis and John Jumper, who was a staff research scientist when the project began and who eventually became a VP and engineering fellow, won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their work on AlphaFold.
DeepMind then launched the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database , giving researchers free access to over 200 million protein structure predictions.
"Our strategy over the last nine years has been to focus on grand challenges... a concrete goal every project is focused on," said Pushmeet Kohli, the VP of research at Google DeepMind.
summaryLinesKo: 2024년에는 DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis와 프로젝트 시작 당시 직원 연구 과학자였으며 나중에 VP 겸 엔지니어링 펠로우가 된 John Jumper가 AlphaFold에 대한 연구로 노벨 화학상을 수상함
그런 다음 DeepMind는 AlphaFold 단백질 구조 데이터베이스를 출시하여 연구자들이 2억 개가 넘는 단백질 구조 예측에 무료로 액세스할 수 있도록 함
Google DeepMind의 연구 부사장인 Pushmeet Kohli는 "지난 9년 동안 우리의 전략은 모든 프로젝트가 초점을 맞추고 있는 구체적인 목표인 거대한 도전에 초점을 맞추는 것이었음" · 라고 말함

articles.title: OpenAI’s Rogue AI Agent Hacked More Than Just Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: OpenAI’s Rogue AI Agent Hacked More Than Just Hugging Face
articles.titleKo: OpenAI의 악성 AI 에이전트는 단순히 얼굴을 껴안는 것 이상을 해킹함
articles.summary:
Hugging Face’s own postmortem published this week describes an intrusion that reached far further into its internal systems than the initial disclosures suggested.
The company says it reviewed roughly 17,600 agent actions that it recovered from logs between July 9 and July 13—the majority of which were paths the agent took that failed.
OpenAI said Tuesday that the rogue AI agent that breached Hugging Face’s platform also hacked multiple third-party accounts and services as part of the attack.

articles.title: Frontier AI developers urge international coordination to pace automated research before capabilities outstrip control
articles.titleEn: Frontier AI developers urge international coordination to pace automated research before capabilities outstrip control
articles.titleKo: 프론티어 AI 개발자들은 능력이 통제를 뛰어넘기 전에 자동화된 연구를 가속화하기 위해 국제적 협력을 촉구함
articles.summary:
Their argument is simple: no single company or country can slow things down alone.
The pace of progress is accelerating on its own, and many researchers consider recursive self-improvement a real factor.
According to the "Pacing the Frontier" statement, competitive pressure makes it impossible for any single company or country to slow down on its own, even though the signatories disagree on what specific measures should look like.

Data security company Cyera, which recently raised $600 million at a $12 billion valuation, announced Tuesday that it signed a letter of intent to acquire Oasis Security for approximately $1 billion in a deal expected to be paid mostly in cash, with the remainder in Cyera shares.

articles.title: As AI content floods the internet, Pangram raises $9M to detect it
articles.titleEn: As AI content floods the internet, Pangram raises $9M to detect it
articles.titleKo: AI 콘텐츠가 인터넷에 넘쳐나자 Pangram은 이를 탐지하기 위해 900만 달러를 모금함
articles.summary:
New York-based AI detection startup Pangram is on a mission to combat the AI slop infestation spreading across the internet, and it just raised $9 million on a bet that demand for tools that distinguish human-generated content from AI-generated text will only grow.
Stanford AI and machine learning grads Max Spero and Bradley Emi launched Pangram about two years ago, after the launch of ChatGPT opened the floodgates for an internet full of bots, AI-generated SEO slop content, and what Spero calls “LLM-powered Russian disinformation campaigns and UAE-influenced campaigns on Twitter.”
Pangram’s technology, while not perfect, could help fuel the resistance to accepting the AI-generated content flooding the internet, the courtroom, and academic papers.
summaryLinesEn: New York-based AI detection startup Pangram is on a mission to combat the AI slop infestation spreading across the internet, and it just raised $9 million on a bet that demand for tools that distinguish human-generated content from AI-generated text will only grow.

Stanford AI and machine learning grads Max Spero and Bradley Emi launched Pangram about two years ago, after the launch of ChatGPT opened the floodgates for an internet full of bots, AI-generated SEO slop content, and what Spero calls “LLM-powered Russian disinformation campaigns and UAE-influenced campaigns on Twitter.”
Pangram’s technology, while not perfect, could help fuel the resistance to accepting the AI-generated content flooding the internet, the courtroom, and academic papers.
summaryLinesKo: 뉴욕에 본사를 둔 AI 감지 스타트업 Pangram은 인터넷을 통해 확산되는 AI 슬롭 침입에 맞서 싸우는 임무를 수행하고 있으며, 인간 생성 콘텐츠와 AI 생성 텍스트를 구별하는 도구에 대한 수요가 계속 증가할 것이라는 내기에서 900만 달러를 모금함
Stanford AI 및 기계 학습 졸업생인 Max Spero와 Bradley Emi는 약 2년 전 Pangram을 출시함 · ChatGPT가 출시된 후 봇, AI 생성 SEO 슬롭 콘텐츠 및 Spero가 "LLM 기반 러시아 허위 정보 캠페인 및 Twitter에서 UAE에 영향을 받은 캠페인"으로 가득 찬 인터넷의 수문을 열었음
Pangram의 기술은 완벽하지는 않지만 인터넷, 법정, 학술 논문에 넘쳐나는 AI 생성 콘텐츠를 받아들이는 데 대한 저항을 부채질하는 데 도움이 될 수 있음

articles.title: OpenAI’s rogue AI agent didn’t stop at hacking Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: OpenAI’s rogue AI agent didn’t stop at hacking Hugging Face
articles.titleKo: OpenAI의 악성 AI 에이전트는 Hugging Face 해킹에 그치지 않았음
articles.summary:
In an update to a blog post detailing its ongoing investigation into the incident, OpenAI said the wayward AI agent attacked several “publicly-available services” in its efforts to reach Hugging Face.
The AI agent that escaped from OpenAI and hacked developer platform Hugging Face attacked other companies as well, OpenAI revealed on Tuesday.
“Based on our review to date, we have not identified any other activity at the level of severity or scale of what we’ve shared related to Hugging Face, which involved a platform-level compromise,” OpenAI said.
summaryLinesEn: In an update to a blog post detailing its ongoing investigation into the incident, OpenAI said the wayward AI agent attacked several “publicly-available services” in its efforts to reach Hugging Face.

“Based on our review to date, we have not identified any other activity at the level of severity or scale of what we’ve shared related to Hugging Face, which involved a platform-level compromise,” OpenAI said.
summaryLinesKo: OpenAI는 사건에 대해 진행 중인 조사를 자세히 설명하는 블로그 게시물 업데이트에서 변덕스러운 AI 에이전트가 Hugging Face에 접근하기 위한 노력으로 여러 "공개적으로 사용 가능한 서비스"를 공격했다고 밝힘
오픈AI에서 탈출한 AI 에이전트가 개발자 플랫폼 허깅페이스를 해킹해 다른 기업도 공격했다고 오픈AI가 화요일 밝힘
OpenAI는 “현재까지 검토한 결과 플랫폼 수준의 손상이 포함된 Hugging Face와 관련하여 우리가 공유한 것의 심각도나 규모 수준에서 다른 활동을 식별하지 못함” · 라고 말함

articles.title: Pangram says its new AI text detector makes only one mistake per 24,000 documents
articles.titleEn: Pangram says its new AI text detector makes only one mistake per 24,000 documents
articles.titleKo: Pangram은 새로운 AI 텍스트 탐지기가 24,000개의 문서당 단 한 번의 실수만 한다고 말함
articles.summary:
In the company's own benchmarks, it correctly identifies 99.66 percent of all AI text and falsely flags human writing just 0.0041 percent of the time, roughly one error per 24,000 documents.
All plans now include image scanning at no extra cost.
The API costs $0.05 per 100 words, a two- to tenfold price increase depending on document length.
summaryLinesEn: In the company's own benchmarks, it correctly identifies 99.66 percent of all AI text and falsely flags human writing just 0.0041 percent of the time, roughly one error per 24,000 documents.

Nvidia's new alliance says yes Backing this up, Nvidia's brand-new Open Secure AI Alliance "will work to remediate and disclose vulnerabilities using open technologies."
The difference between open-source AI and weights , according to the Open Source Initiative (OSI) , is that open weights usually means the trained weights are available, but not necessarily the full training data or source code.
The open-weight Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 is faster than Anthropic Fable 5 in some ways, and is nearly as fast as Fable 5 and OpenAI's GPT-5.6 in others.

articles.title: Altman says he supports AI regulation
articles.titleEn: Altman says he supports AI regulation
articles.titleKo: Altman은 AI 규제를 지지한다고 밝힘
articles.summary:
OpenAI’s Sam Altman said he supports legislation to slow AI development during his visit to Capitol Hill on Wednesday, as debate swirls in Washington and Silicon Valley over safety risks posed by frontier models.
Lawmakers are under pressure to move as quickly as AI has, but “making decisions based on fears” risks ineffective or self-defeating policy, Semafor Tech Editor Reed Albergotti argued: Instead of banning Chinese models, Washington’s “ best counterpunch ” is to help companies use them safely.
OpenAI changed tack after two of its agents went rogue, days ahead of the White House’s Aug. 1 deadline for developing an AI safety framework; Washington is also considering curbs on China’s open-source AI, generating disagreements between tech leaders over the necessity of guardrails.
summaryLinesEn: OpenAI’s Sam Altman said he supports legislation to slow AI development during his visit to Capitol Hill on Wednesday, as debate swirls in Washington and Silicon Valley over safety risks posed by frontier models.

Lawmakers are under pressure to move as quickly as AI has, but “making decisions based on fears” risks ineffective or self-defeating policy, Semafor Tech Editor Reed Albergotti argued: Instead of banning Chinese models, Washington’s “ best counterpunch ” is to help companies use them safely.

OpenAI changed tack after two of its agents went rogue, days ahead of the White House’s Aug. 1 deadline for developing an AI safety framework; Washington is also considering curbs on China’s open-source AI, generating disagreements between tech leaders over the necessity of guardrails.

국회의원들은 AI만큼 빠르게 움직여야 한다는 압력을 받고 있지만 "두려움에 기반한 결정을 내리는 것은 비효율적이거나 자멸적인 정책을 초래할 위험이 있습니다"라고 Semafor 기술 편집자 Reed Albergotti는 다음과 같이 주장함 · 중국 모델을 금지하는 대신 미국의 "최고의 반격"은 기업이 이를 안전하게 사용할 수 있도록 돕는 것임
OpenAI는 백악관의 AI 안전 프레임워크 개발 마감일인 8월 1일을 며칠 앞두고 두 명의 에이전트가 불량 행위를 한 후 방향을 바꿨음 · 워싱턴은 또한 중국의 오픈 소스 AI에 대한 억제를 고려하고 있으며, 이로 인해 가드레일의 필요성에 대해 기술 리더들 사이에 의견 차이가 발생하고 있음

국회의원들은 AI만큼 빠르게 움직여야 한다는 압력을 받고 있지만 "두려움에 기반한 결정을 내리는 것은 비효율적이거나 자멸적인 정책을 초래할 위험이 있습니다"라고 Semafor 기술 편집자 Reed Albergotti는 다음과 같이 주장함 · 중국 모델을 금지하는 대신 미국의 "최고의 반격"은 기업이 이를 안전하게 사용할 수 있도록 돕는 것임
OpenAI는 백악관의 AI 안전 프레임워크 개발 마감일인 8월 1일을 며칠 앞두고 두 명의 에이전트가 불량 행위를 한 후 방향을 바꿨음 · 워싱턴은 또한 중국의 오픈 소스 AI에 대한 억제를 고려하고 있으며, 이로 인해 가드레일의 필요성에 대해 기술 리더들 사이에 의견 차이가 발생하고 있음

articles.title: Perplexity’s Personal Computer turns Windows PCs into AI agents
articles.titleEn: Perplexity’s Personal Computer turns Windows PCs into AI agents
articles.titleKo: Perplexity의 개인용 컴퓨터는 Windows PC를 AI 에이전트로 전환함
articles.summary:
Personal Computer for Windows is rolling out to paying Max and Enterprise Max users today, on subscription tiers that start from $200 per month.
Perplexity has expanded its agentic Personal Computer tool to Windows, allowing computers running the world’s most popular OS to be used as a locally run AI system.
Like the Mac version that Perplexity launched in April, Personal Computer for Windows operates like a “general-purpose digital worker” that can access local files and apps to perform actions on your behalf, such as creating documents and updating spreadsheets.
summaryLinesEn: Personal Computer for Windows is rolling out to paying Max and Enterprise Max users today, on subscription tiers that start from $200 per month.
Perplexity has expanded its agentic Personal Computer tool to Windows, allowing computers running the world’s most popular OS to be used as a locally run AI system.

Like the Mac version that Perplexity launched in April, Personal Computer for Windows operates like a “general-purpose digital worker” that can access local files and apps to perform actions on your behalf, such as creating documents and updating spreadsheets.
summaryLinesKo: Windows용 개인용 컴퓨터는 오늘 월 200달러부터 시작하는 구독 계층의 Max 및 Enterprise Max 유료 사용자에게 출시됨
Perplexity는 에이전트용 개인용 컴퓨터 도구를 Windows로 확장하여 세계에서 가장 인기 있는 OS를 실행하는 컴퓨터를 로컬에서 실행되는 AI 시스템으로 사용할 수 있도록 함
Perplexity가 4월에 출시한 Mac 버전과 마찬가지로 Windows용 개인용 컴퓨터는 로컬 파일 및 앱에 액세스하여 문서 작성 및 스프레드시트 업데이트와 같은 작업을 대신 수행할 수 있는 "범용 디지털 작업자"처럼 작동함

articles.title: Runway couldn't fix a bug in its AI video model, so it turned the bug into a feature
articles.titleEn: Runway couldn't fix a bug in its AI video model, so it turned the bug into a feature
articles.titleKo: Runway는 AI 비디오 모델의 버그를 수정할 수 없어 버그를 기능으로 전환함
articles.summary:
Shortly after launching Runway Characters, he said the team noticed that 8% of API calls were dropping to 16 frames per second, causing the video to stutter for customers.
They introduced a frontend feature called "Optimize for Image Quality," which automatically re-centers the user's image before generation begins.
According to Phillips, distillation helps Runway cut down “80 to 90% of the generation time.”
summaryLinesEn: Shortly after launching Runway Characters, he said the team noticed that 8% of API calls were dropping to 16 frames per second, causing the video to stutter for customers.
They introduced a frontend feature called "Optimize for Image Quality," which automatically re-centers the user's image before generation begins.
According to Phillips, distillation helps Runway cut down “80 to 90% of the generation time.”
summaryLinesKo: 그는 Runway Character를 출시한 직후 API 호출의 8%가 초당 16프레임으로 떨어지고 고객이 볼 때 비디오가 끊기는 현상이 발생한다는 사실을 팀에서 발견했다고 말함
그들은 생성이 시작되기 전에 사용자 이미지의 중앙을 자동으로 다시 맞추는 "이미지 품질 최적화"라는 프런트엔드 기능을 도입함
Phillips에 따르면 증류는 Runway가 "생성 시간의 80~90%"를 줄이는 데 도움이 됨

articles.title: Data centers may face temporary power cuts to prevent blackouts on largest US grid
articles.titleEn: Data centers may face temporary power cuts to prevent blackouts on largest US grid
articles.titleKo: 데이터 센터는 미국 최대 전력망의 정전을 방지하기 위해 일시적인 정전에 직면할 수 있음
articles.summary:
Now, after an auction to add more generating capacity fell short, the grid’s operator, PJM Interconnection, has said it will cut off data centers and other large users during power shortages.
PJM won’t start curtailing supply until June 2027, and the cuts will only apply to data centers that are 50 megawatts or larger.
By 2035, data centers are expected to use 4x more electricity than they do today.

articles.title: AI leaders sign a statement asking the government to do something about automated AI
articles.titleEn: AI leaders sign a statement asking the government to do something about automated AI
articles.titleKo: AI 지도자들은 자동화된 AI에 대해 정부에 조치를 취하도록 요청하는 성명서에 서명함
articles.summary:
Employees of OpenAI and Anthropic, as well as Google, Meta, Thinking Machines, Microsoft, Mistral, and other leading AI labs, have written a statement to the US government supporting a potential slowdown of sorts for frontier AI development — or at least a speed-up of global coordinated governance efforts.
Building on work already underway to monitor frontier model releases: We request that the U.S. government support an international effort to develop the technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated Al development.”
“Al could help create a dramatically better future, but that outcome is not guaranteed,” the employees wrote in the statement.
summaryLinesEn: Employees of OpenAI and Anthropic, as well as Google, Meta, Thinking Machines, Microsoft, Mistral, and other leading AI labs, have written a statement to the US government supporting a potential slowdown of sorts for frontier AI development — or at least a speed-up of global coordinated governance efforts.

Building on work already underway to monitor frontier model releases: We request that the U.S. government support an international effort to develop the technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated Al development.”
“Al could help create a dramatically better future, but that outcome is not guaranteed,” the employees wrote in the statement.
summaryLinesKo: OpenAI 및 Anthropic은 물론 Google, Meta, Thinking Machines, Microsoft, Mistral 및 기타 주요 AI 연구소의 직원들은 미국 정부에 최첨단 AI 개발의 잠재적 둔화 또는 적어도 글로벌 조정 거버넌스 노력의 속도 향상을 지지하는 성명서를 작성함
최첨단 모델 출시를 모니터링하기 위해 이미 진행 중인 작업을 기반으로 · 우리는 미국 정부가 자동화된 AI 개발의 최전선을 의도적으로 진행하는 데 필요한 기술 및 거버넌스 도구를 개발하기 위한 국제적인 노력을 지원할 것을 요청함”

articles.titleKo: AI는 마침내 월스트리트를 불안하게 만들만큼 비쌉니
articles.summary:
It’s earnings season, and investors got an unpleasant surprise from Google: an increase on its spending estimate , to as much as $205 billion — from the last quarter’s projection of up to $190 billion.
They are invested in the space anyway because they think the companies that survive will make them more money than they will lose on the ones that die off.
Even the lower end of Google’s new projected range — $195 billion — is much more than the company had previously forecast as its top end spending.

articles.titleEn: Nvidia invests in Ilya Sutskever's AI lab, shifting SSI away from Google chips
articles.titleKo: Nvidia는 Ilya Sutskever의 AI 연구소에 투자하여 SSI를 Google 칩에서 전환함
articles.summary:
The company raised about $2 billion from Andreessen Horowitz, Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and Greenoaks, and was most recently valued at roughly $30 billion .
The deal also helps Nvidia fend off Google as a rival chip supplier during the current AI boom.
As part of a long-term partnership, SSI gets access to Nvidia's next-generation Vera Rubin GPU platform, which the companies say will boost its compute capacity tenfold.

articles.summary:
At the Times I think about just the outsize investment we are making on behalf of the public's right to know.
The Times has arguably never been stronger as a business, having recently surpassed 13 million subscribers, and its newsroom is widely seen among journalists as one of the most stable and well-resourced in the business.
For most companies, spending upwards of $20 million on a single legal fight with an uncertain outcome might mean the boss has some explaining to do.

articles.summary:
That means OpenAI has recently changed how it deals with such requests, as a recent study by publication No Latency showed that ChatGPT didn't refuse them for dead authors.

And because it's a place where people share ideas, users can compare, benchmark and optimize those tools.

articles.titleKo: Anthropic의 Dario Amodei는 다음과 같이 응답함 · 개방형 모델에 반대하지는 않지만 중국 AI를 두려워함
articles.summary:
His response came after Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang took to X ( his first post on the platform) to share an open letter on Friday in which Nvidia and a long list of other AI companies including Hugging Face, Meta, Microsoft, Mistral, and Nvidia urged policymakers not to impose broad “premature restrictions” on open-weight AI models.
“I think this idea is actually close to a consensus: I have been heartened both that the Trump administration has moved in this direction in recent months, and by recent industry proposals that would apply such testing to the most capable models regardless of their country of origin or whether they are open or closed (while exempting less capable models, such as those from startups and academia, entirely),” Amodei wrote.
And, in his view, open-weight models are more dangerous in those scenarios because it’s difficult to apply guardrails to them or monitor their usage.
summaryLinesEn: His response came after Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang took to X ( his first post on the platform) to share an open letter on Friday in which Nvidia and a long list of other AI companies including Hugging Face, Meta, Microsoft, Mistral, and Nvidia urged policymakers not to impose broad “premature restrictions” on open-weight AI models.

“I think this idea is actually close to a consensus: I have been heartened both that the Trump administration has moved in this direction in recent months, and by recent industry proposals that would apply such testing to the most capable models regardless of their country of origin or whether they are open or closed (while exempting less capable models, such as those from startups and academia, entirely),” Amodei wrote.
And, in his view, open-weight models are more dangerous in those scenarios because it’s difficult to apply guardrails to them or monitor their usage.
summaryLinesKo: 그의 반응은 Nvidia 창립자이자 CEO인 Jensen Huang이 금요일에 Nvidia와 Hugging Face, Meta, Microsoft, Mistral 및 Nvidia를 포함한 다른 AI 회사들의 긴 목록이 정책 입안자들에게 개방형 AI 모델에 광범위한 "성급한 제한"을 부과하지 말 것을 촉구하는 공개 서한을 공유하기 위해 X(플랫폼에 대한 첫 번째 게시물)를 방문한 후에 나왔음
Amodei는 "나는 이 아이디어가 실제로 합의에 가깝다고 생각함 · 나는 트럼프 행정부가 최근 몇 달 동안 이런 방향으로 움직였다는 사실과 출신 국가나 개방 여부에 상관없이 가장 유능한 모델에 이러한 테스트를 적용하겠다는 최근 업계 제안에 고무됐다"고 말함
그리고 그의 견해로는 개방형 모델은 가드레일을 적용하거나 사용량을 모니터링하기 어렵기 때문에 이러한 시나리오에서 더 위험함

articles.title: AI company employees petition US government for regulation - Engadget
articles.titleEn: AI company employees petition US government for regulation - Engadget
articles.titleKo: AI 기업 직원들, 미국 정부에 규제 청원 - Engadget
articles.summary:
A collection of employees at major artificial intelligence firms has created a petition asking for the federal government to help "deliberately pace" the development of the transformative technology.
"We request that the US government support an international effort to develop the technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development," the petition states.
The letter claims there is "a real risk" of AI "understand or control" Although those do seem like logical and necessary statements, this move for change via petition feels confusing.
summaryLinesEn: A collection of employees at major artificial intelligence firms has created a petition asking for the federal government to help "deliberately pace" the development of the transformative technology.

"We request that the US government support an international effort to develop the technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development," the petition states.
The letter claims there is "a real risk" of AI "understand or control" Although those do seem like logical and necessary statements, this move for change via petition feels confusing.

청원서에는 "우리는 미국 정부가 자동화된 AI 개발의 최전선을 의도적으로 보조하는 데 필요한 기술 및 거버넌스 도구를 개발하기 위한 국제적 노력을 지원할 것을 요청합니다"라고 명시되어 있음

articles.title: Closing the data loop in AI-driven drug discovery
articles.titleEn: Closing the data loop in AI-driven drug discovery
articles.titleKo: AI 기반 신약 발견의 데이터 루프 종료
articles.summary:
Today, bringing a new drug to market takes an average of 10-15 years and costs anywhere from $1 billion to $2.5 billion , with failure rates upward of 90%.
Belcher has seen a shift from empirical screening to predictive design: Instead of physically screening libraries, drug companies are now using AI to design drug candidates from scratch and predict how they will interact with disease targets before committing anything to research and development (R&D).
“The main cost in drug discovery is still the clinical phase, so trying to reduce risk and increase your success rates there is obviously hugely beneficial,” says Paul Belcher, director of protein research strategy at global life sciences company Cytiva.
summaryLinesEn: Today, bringing a new drug to market takes an average of 10-15 years and costs anywhere from $1 billion to $2.5 billion , with failure rates upward of 90%.

Belcher has seen a shift from empirical screening to predictive design: Instead of physically screening libraries, drug companies are now using AI to design drug candidates from scratch and predict how they will interact with disease targets before committing anything to research and development (R&D).

“The main cost in drug discovery is still the clinical phase, so trying to reduce risk and increase your success rates there is obviously hugely beneficial,” says Paul Belcher, director of protein research strategy at global life sciences company Cytiva.

Belcher는 경험적 스크리닝에서 예측 설계로 전환함 · 제약 회사는 이제 라이브러리를 물리적으로 스크리닝하는 대신 AI를 사용하여 약물 후보를 처음부터 설계하고 연구 개발(R&D)에 착수하기 전에 질병 표적과 상호 작용하는 방식을 예측하고 있음
글로벌 생명과학 기업인 Cytiva의 단백질 연구 전략 이사인 Paul Belcher는 “약물 발견의 주요 비용은 여전히 ​​임상 단계이므로 위험을 줄이고 성공률을 높이려는 노력은 분명히 큰 이점이 있음” · 라고 말함

articles.title: Nvidia, Microsoft launch open AI security alliance — without OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic
articles.titleEn: Nvidia, Microsoft launch open AI security alliance — without OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic
articles.titleKo: Nvidia, Microsoft, OpenAI, Google 또는 Anthropic 없이 개방형 AI 보안 동맹 출시
articles.summary:
Nvidia on Monday said it is joining forces with Microsoft, SpaceX, IBM, and other tech companies to build and share open-source AI security tools.
That company, Hugging Face, said it was forced to use a Chinese open-weight model to defend itself due to the strict safety guardrails limiting the usefulness of top US models.
Nvidia and its partners argue that securing AI requires access to both closed and open models, stressing that defenders need the tools to counter emerging threats.
summaryLinesEn: Nvidia on Monday said it is joining forces with Microsoft, SpaceX, IBM, and other tech companies to build and share open-source AI security tools.

Nvidia and its partners argue that securing AI requires access to both closed and open models, stressing that defenders need the tools to counter emerging threats.

해당 회사인 Hugging Face는 미국 상위 모델의 유용성을 제한하는 엄격한 안전 가드레일로 인해 자체 방어를 위해 중국산 개방형 모델을 사용할 수밖에 없었다고 말함
Nvidia와 파트너는 AI를 확보하려면 폐쇄형 모델과 개방형 모델 모두에 액세스해야 한다고 주장하며 방어자에게는 새로운 위협에 대응할 수 있는 도구가 필요하다고 강조함

articles.titleEn: NVIDIA launches 'Open Secure AI Alliance' initiative to improve cyber defense - Engadget
articles.titleKo: NVIDIA, 사이버 방어 개선을 위한 'Open Secure AI Alliance' 이니셔티브 개시 - Engadget
articles.summary:
NVIDIA and some of its partners are stepping up to contribute different elements to the alliance.
It added that regulators should recognize open models as "defensive assets, not liabilities," saying that blanket restrictions on open frontier AI systems "weaken defensive capacity and risk concentrating power" to a few closed providers.
"When closed AI tools — unable to distinguish attackers from defenders — blocked essential forensic analysis, Hugging Face ran the open-weight GLM 5.2 model on its own infrastructure to analyze more than 17,000 actions and contain the intrusion," NVIDIA wrote.

"When closed AI tools — unable to distinguish attackers from defenders — blocked essential forensic analysis, Hugging Face ran the open-weight GLM 5.2 model on its own infrastructure to analyze more than 17,000 actions and contain the intrusion," NVIDIA wrote.

규제 당국은 개방형 모델을 '부채가 아닌 방어 자산'으로 인식해야 하며, 개방형 프론티어 AI 시스템에 대한 전면적인 제한은 소수의 폐쇄형 제공업체에 대한 '방어 능력을 약화시키고 위험 집중력을 약화시킨다'고 덧붙였음
NVIDIA는 "공격자와 방어자를 구분할 수 없는 폐쇄형 AI 도구가 필수 포렌식 분석을 차단했을 때 Hugging Face는 자체 인프라에서 개방형 GLM 5.2 모델을 실행하여 17,000개 이상의 작업을 분석하고 침입을 억제함" · 라고 밝힘

articles.title: How would AI data centers in space even work? A former NASA robotics chief explains
articles.titleEn: How would AI data centers in space even work? A former NASA robotics chief explains
articles.titleKo: 우주에 있는 AI 데이터 센터는 어떻게 작동할까요 · 전 NASA 로봇 공학 책임자가 설명함
articles.summary:
However, if data centers make it to the moon, you can expect a 1.6-second lag back and forth with transmissions, Ambrose added.
At NASA, for instance, "every piece of flight hardware that I've ever been responsible for that's been launched into space has had to go through vibration tests.
Currently, it costs SpaceX about $2,900 per kilogram to launch a payload, and that number needs to drop below $500 to make space data centers economically viable.

summaryLinesKo: 그러나 데이터 센터가 달에 도착하면 전송 시 1.6초의 지연이 발생할 수 있다고 Ambrose는 덧붙였음
예를 들어 NASA에서는 "우주로 발사되는 우주 비행 하드웨어의 모든 부품은 진동 테스트를 거쳐야 함
현재 SpaceX는 페이로드를 발사하는 데 킬로그램당 약 2,900달러의 비용이 들며, 우주 데이터 센터를 경제적으로 실행 가능하게 만들려면 그 숫자를 500달러 미만으로 줄여야 함

articles.title: Google's AI search is rapidly becoming the default, new data shows
articles.titleEn: Google's AI search is rapidly becoming the default, new data shows
articles.titleKo: 구글의 AI 검색이 빠르게 기본이 되고 있다는 새로운 데이터가 나타남
articles.summary:
During the same period, AI Mode visits rose from 126 million in June 2025 to 279 million by May 2026.
In just a year’s time, Google’s AI-generated answers in search, known as AI Overviews , have gone from appearing in 15% of searches to 43%, according to a new report, driving a shift in how web users consume information online.
This change has not been welcomed by publishers, who are losing out on referral traffic due to the rise of AI citations that don’t lead to clicks.

articles.summary:
Encord’s work with Zander is currently a trial run; Encord says the goal is to build an initial brain wave-tagged data set, run it through customer robotics models, and evaluate whether it actually improves performance before deciding whether to scale it up.
But “20 times more” is still real money, and that’s the catch: scraping text off the internet, the way LLM makers built their models by pulling from Stack Overflow and the rest of the web, cost frontier labs next to nothing.
Velmurugan estimates this kind of dense annotation is worth 100 times as much as “junky ego data” for training specific tasks, and it only costs 20 times more to produce, which is a good trade, on paper.

articles.title: OpenAI says more workers are using ChatGPT to do other people's jobs

articles.summary:
Of more than 800,000 work-related ChatGPT messages analyzed, 43.5 percent of job-specific queries involved another profession.
OpenAI sees the usage data as an early signal that job profiles are shifting, even before job titles or descriptions catch up.
OpenAI says more people are using AI for work outside their professions.

articles.title: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3 open weights and infrastructure after shaking up the frontier model race
articles.titleEn: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3 open weights and infrastructure after shaking up the frontier model race
articles.titleKo: Moonshot AI, 프론티어 모델 경쟁을 뒤흔든 Kimi K3 오픈 웨이트 및 인프라 출시
articles.summary:
Since its initial announcement in mid-July 2026, Kimi K3 has caused a stir by scoring close to Western frontier models such as Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol on popular benchmarks, but at a slightly lower cost and now with open weights.
Chinese AI company Moonshot AI has released the model weights and technical report for Kimi K3.
Along with the model weights on Hugging Face , the company is open-sourcing parts of its infrastructure, including high-performance attention kernels, an MoE communication library, and tools for running AI agents at scale.

articles.title: The AI giants’ new problem: open AI
articles.titleEn: The AI giants’ new problem: open AI
articles.titleKo: AI 거인의 새로운 문제 · 개방형 AI
articles.summary:
A more plausible outcome could be a “portfolio strategy,” she said, with companies keeping “their very best model proprietary while releasing increasingly capable open-weight models to maintain developer adoption and ecosystem influence.”
If a generation of tools and developers start building around capable open-weight models like Kimi K3, the industry’s center of gravity could start to shift away from proprietary platforms like Gemini, Claude, and ChatGPT.
Together, this means open-weight AI cannot be re-created from the ground up in the way true open-source software can.

articles.summary:
On Sunday, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella doubled down on the shocking warning he issued earlier this month to businesses that use AI, taking it a step further this time.
When Zakaria asked Nadella to explain what constitutes a company sharing too much with an AI model provider, Nadella said businesses need to be wary of everything they hand over, from their data to their prompts.
Nadella’s point: Companies should hold on to their own usage data so they can eventually build a model of their own.)

articles.title: Private Claude Chats Exposed in Google and Bing Search Results
articles.titleEn: Private Claude Chats Exposed in Google and Bing Search Results
articles.titleKo: Google 및 Bing 검색 결과에 노출된 비공개 Claude 채팅
articles.summary:
Bing, which still shows “about 612 results” if you search “site: claude.ai/share ” at the time of this writing, says in its technical documentation that developers can block the search engine’s web crawlers using robots.txt—but that web developers should also include a “noindex” tag on individual pages as well.
Basically, Anthropic instructs web crawlers, like those used by search engines like Google and Bing, not to index chats a user decides to share with other people.
Some of the chats that showed up in search results flagged in the Reddit post were deleted by the time WIRED viewed them, and results no longer show up in Google when you search the “share” query that still worked on Bing.

기본적으로 Anthropic은 사용자가 다른 사람들과 공유하기로 결정한 채팅을 색인화하지 않도록 Google 및 Bing과 같은 검색 엔진에서 사용되는 것과 같은 웹 크롤러에 지시함

기본적으로 Anthropic은 사용자가 다른 사람들과 공유하기로 결정한 채팅을 색인화하지 않도록 Google 및 Bing과 같은 검색 엔진에서 사용되는 것과 같은 웹 크롤러에 지시함
Reddit 게시물에 표시된 검색 결과에 표시된 일부 채팅은 WIRED가 해당 게시물을 볼 때 삭제되었으며 Bing에서 여전히 작동하는 "공유" 쿼리를 검색하면 결과가 더 이상 Google에 표시되지 않음

articles.summary:
He basically said the US should create regulatory FUD — fear, uncertainty, and doubt — and muck up the ability for these open weight models to compete with the US.
So you really have to ask the question: Are we accelerating and ensuring that Americans win the AI race, or are we ensuring that certain frontier labs do better than others?
Beyond suggesting that certain folks should “touch grass” rather than spending their weekends arguing on X, Sean noted that in many ways, this “feels like we’re seeing repeats of prior freakouts,” with everyone in Silicon Valley “expecting that something is going to arrive and blow everything else away.”

articles.title: Monday.com is the latest tech company to blame AI for layoffs — here are 20 others
articles.titleEn: Monday.com is the latest tech company to blame AI for layoffs — here are 20 others
articles.titleKo: Monday.com은 해고의 원인으로 AI를 비난한 최신 기술 회사임 · 여기에는 20개의 다른 회사가 있음
articles.summary:
Monday.com, the Tel Aviv-based work management software company known for its colorful, customizable project-tracking boards, this week became the latest tech company to cite AI as a factor in job cuts.
Meta, for instance, earlier this year moved roughly 7,000 employees into new AI-focused roles even as it laid off 8,000 others, and IBM says it’s tripling entry-level hiring for AI and hybrid-cloud roles alongside recent cuts.
On Wednesday, the company said in an SEC filing that it will lay off about 20% of its workforce, or just over 600 employees, as part of a “restructuring plan” tied to its “ongoing transformation of its product, marketing, and go-to-market strategy” in support of “a leaner, more focused operating model” as it continues investing in its “AI-driven growth strategy.”

articles.title: Anthropic's Opus 5 blows past Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol on the benchmark designed to measure real intelligence
articles.titleEn: Anthropic's Opus 5 blows past Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol on the benchmark designed to measure real intelligence
articles.titleKo: Anthropic의 Opus 5는 실제 지능을 측정하기 위해 설계된 벤치마크에서 Fable 5 및 GPT-5.6 Sol을 능가함
articles.summary:
Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 scored 30.2 percent on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark, nearly four times the previous record of 7.8 percent set by OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol (Max).
Annotators could have labeled reasoning traces, useful actions, failed attempts, and recovery steps from similar puzzles.
The ARC Prize team attributes the lead to genuinely stronger logical reasoning that enables more autonomous exploration and planning in unfamiliar environments.

주석자는 유사한 퍼즐의 추론 추적, 유용한 작업, 실패한 시도 및 복구 단계에 레이블을 지정할 수 있음

articles.titleEn: SpaceX Is $15 Away From A ‘Worthless’ AI Business Says Morgan Stanley
articles.titleKo: SpaceX는 '가치 없는' AI 사업에서 15달러 더 절약된다고 Morgan Stanley는 말함
articles.summary:
Morgan Stanley analysts recently estimated that if the shares dropped to $100, a short stroll, it would imply that investors valued the entire AI division at $0, as Bloomberg reported .
There are tools like discounted cash flow analysis to help determine the worth of an investment based on future cash flows.
The space launch business has performed about 650 launches, with 85% using reused boosters, and an estimated 80% of 2025 global mass-to-orbit as of March 31, 2026, according to the SpaceX S-1 IPO filing .

articles.title: Can Apple make smart glasses that aren’t a constant privacy threat?
articles.titleEn: Can Apple make smart glasses that aren’t a constant privacy threat?
articles.titleKo: Apple이 지속적으로 개인 정보를 위협하지 않는 스마트 안경을 만들 수 있습니까
articles.summary:
Provides movers and shakers with the info they need to start their day.
As Apple prepares to launch its first smart glasses, the company is also wrestling with how to address consumer privacy concerns, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman .
Gurman reports that Apple has pushed back the launch target from early 2027, with the glasses now set for unveiling at the Worldwide Developers Conference in June 2027 and actually becoming available by the end of the year.

articles.titleEn: A Dark Horse Company Matures Under The SpaceX Flag
articles.titleKo: SpaceX 깃발 아래 성숙해지는 다크호스 회사
articles.summary:
SpaceX recently acquired Cursor, an AI-native editor tool developed by Anysphere, for $60 billion in an all-stock deal shortly after its IPO.
There were also proponents, like Bill Ackman, who was quoted as saying: "the Cursor acquisition costs materially less in dilution because of SpaceX's high valuation."
Elon Musk’s space exploration company is making a lot of headlines right now, especially as its stock goes up and down, but there’s a hidden gem in the SpaceX crown that I think deserves a lot more attention.

articles.title: One fallen power line exposed a growing AI data center problem. Here's how to fix it.
articles.titleEn: One fallen power line exposed a growing AI data center problem. Here's how to fix it.
articles.titleKo: 하나의 떨어진 전력선으로 인해 점점 커지는 AI 데이터 센터 문제가 드러났음 · 문제를 해결하는 방법은 다음과 같음
articles.summary:
When the power line went down this week, it triggered data centers to switch to backup power, and about 3.1 gigawatts of load vanished in about 30 seconds, according to PJM data .
But this one took more than 10 minutes because more than 3 gigawatts of data centers stopped drawing power nearly simultaneously.
ON.Energy is currently installing a total of 3 gigawatts worth of its systems at four different data center campuses, de Azevedo said.

하지만 3기가와트 이상의 데이터 센터가 거의 동시에 전력 공급을 중단했기 때문에 이 작업에는 10분 이상이 걸렸음

articles.title: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 costs well below Fable 5 while matching or beating it across most benchmarks
articles.titleEn: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 costs well below Fable 5 while matching or beating it across most benchmarks
articles.titleKo: Anthropic의 Claude Opus 5 가격은 Fable 5보다 훨씬 낮지만 대부분의 벤치마크에서 일치하거나 능가함
articles.summary:
Lower reasoning tiers deliver better value and coding results The average Intelligence Index task costs $2.03 with Opus 5, less than Claude Fable 5 with fallback at $2.75.
Cache writes cost $6.25 per million tokens with a five-minute lifetime, while cache hits run just $0.50 per million tokens.
Because Opus 5 tends to respond more frequently even when uncertain, its hallucination rate climbs to 50 percent, raising questions about reliability in high-stakes applications.
summaryLinesEn: Lower reasoning tiers deliver better value and coding results The average Intelligence Index task costs $2.03 with Opus 5, less than Claude Fable 5 with fallback at $2.75.
Cache writes cost $6.25 per million tokens with a five-minute lifetime, while cache hits run just $0.50 per million tokens.
Because Opus 5 tends to respond more frequently even when uncertain, its hallucination rate climbs to 50 percent, raising questions about reliability in high-stakes applications.
summaryLinesKo: 낮은 추론 계층은 더 나은 가치와 코딩 결과를 제공함 · Opus 5의 평균 Intelligence Index 작업 비용은 2.03달러로 대체 비용이 포함된 Claude Fable 5의 2.75달러보다 저렴함
캐시 쓰기 비용은 5분 동안 토큰 백만 개당 6.25달러인 반면, 캐시 적중은 토큰 백만 개당 0.50달러에 불과함
Opus 5는 불확실한 경우에도 더 자주 반응하는 경향이 있기 때문에 환각 비율이 50%까지 올라가 고위험 애플리케이션의 신뢰성에 대한 의문이 제기됨

articles.summary:
In a general prompt injection test by security firm Gray Swan , the success rate after 15 attempts dropped from 5.5 percent (Opus 4.8) to 2.0 percent.
Without them, Opus 5 sits at 3.7 percent, and Sonnet 5 actually does better at 0.93 percent.
Prompt injection , where an attacker slips past an AI model's instructions through manipulated inputs like hidden text on a webpage, fails against Opus 5 in almost every case.

articles.summary:
Agentic AI is creating the same requirements and challenges across markets, all of which demand a significant amount of compute.
Whether it’s a humanoid robot or another type of autonomous robot, the need extends beyond GPU computing alone, according to Kirk Saban (pictured), corporate vice president of product marketing and management at Advanced Micro Devices Inc.
“You need GPU compute, but you need CPU compute as well for all of the autonomous functions,” Saban said.

Advanced Micro Devices Inc.의 제품 마케팅 및 관리 담당 기업 부사장인 Kirk Saban(사진)에 따르면 휴머노이드 로봇이든 다른 유형의 자율 로봇이든 GPU 컴퓨팅만으로는 그 필요성이 확장됨

articles.titleEn: AI Act
articles.summary:
Together, these measures guarantee safety, fundamental rights and human-centric AI, and strengthen uptake, investment and innovation in AI across the EU.
While most AI systems pose limited to no risk and can contribute to solving many societal challenges, certain AI systems create risks that we must address to avoid undesirable outcomes.
So, it may become difficult to assess whether someone has been unfairly disadvantaged, such as in a hiring decision or in an application for a public benefit scheme.

articles.title: Prentis, new AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman, Mark Pincus in talks to raise $100M
articles.titleEn: Prentis, new AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman, Mark Pincus in talks to raise $100M
articles.titleKo: 리드 호프만(Reid Hoffman)과 마크 핀커스(Mark Pincus)가 공동 설립한 새로운 AI 연구소 프렌티스(Prentis), 1억 달러 모금 협상 중
articles.summary:
Hoffman, the LinkedIn co-founder and Greylock partner, said last month that he was stepping down from Microsoft’s board after nearly a decade to go “founder mode” on Manas AI, an AI drug-discovery startup he’s also backing; he was an early OpenAI investor and co-founded Inflection AI with Mustafa Suleyman before Microsoft absorbed most of that team in 2024.
Other businesses launched and operated by Titan include AI-powered virtual care provider Tala Health, which raised a $100 million seed round last year, and Forta Health, an autism care startup that raised $55 million led by Insight Partners in 2024.
Prentis will ostensibly develop agents tailored to these customers’ needs, such as handling insurance claims and automating customs duty refund exceptions without needing a human to hunt down paperwork.

Prentis will ostensibly develop agents tailored to these customers’ needs, such as handling insurance claims and automating customs duty refund exceptions without needing a human to hunt down paperwork.

articles.summary:
That's likely the main reason Microsoft and the other signatories are speaking up now.
The company claims MAI performs just as well or better, but only compares it against smaller, less powerful models like GPT-5.4 Mini, Anthropic's Haiku, and "GPT-5.6" without specifying whether that means Sol, Terra, Luna, or which reasoning mode it runs at.

Companies like Meta and Uber are already rethinking their AI usage as well because surprise, surprise, it's really expensive to use all these models.
Brian Barrett: I want to back this up a little bit, too, because I think we haven't mentioned yet that what makes Kimi K3 especially interesting in this context is that it's an open-weight AI system, which means it's not unlike the proprietary systems that are coming out of Anthropic, and OpenAI, and other US-based AI giants.

articles.title: Amazon cracks down on use of AI images by sellers after New York law
articles.titleEn: Amazon cracks down on use of AI images by sellers after New York law
articles.titleKo: 아마존, 뉴욕법 이후 판매자의 AI 이미지 사용 단속
articles.summary:
Outside sellers are the engine behind Amazon's core retail business, accounting for more than 60% of goods sold on its marketplace.
The company has optimized listing titles and details so they're more likely to be spotted by AI systems, invested in a recently rebranded assistant called Alexa for Shopping , and launched a feature that injects AI-generated products into its search bar in real time based on user queries.
"Recent legislation requires disclosure when images or videos in advertisements contain photorealistic AI-generated people," Amazon wrote in the announcement.

articles.title: Runway launches AI model router as generative media gets crowded
articles.titleEn: Runway launches AI model router as generative media gets crowded

articles.summary:
“Most developers are not spending the time to really understand the capabilities of each of these models and where they excel or differ based on various types of outputs across video, image, and audio,” Maggio said.
On Thursday, the startup launched Runway Media Router through Runway Dev , its developer platform, released earlier this month, that provides API access to a growing roster of third-party image, video, and audio models alongside Runway’s own.
The Media Router is a tool that automatically selects the best image, video, or audio generation model for a request based on whether a developer prioritizes quality, speed, or cost.

articles.title: Schneider Electric, AMD Blueprint for AI Factory Deployments
articles.titleEn: Schneider Electric, AMD Blueprint for AI Factory Deployments
articles.titleKo: Schneider Electric, AI 공장 배포를 위한 AMD 청사진
articles.summary:
AI Infrastructure Deployment as an Engineering Challenge The release of the design blueprint comes as AI infrastructure deployment is shifting from securing compute capacity to integrating complex systems across an entire operation spanning power, cooling, networking and operations.
The design is built around AMD’s Helios rackscale platform and can support AI racks with power densities of up to 246kW and modular, multi-cluster environments with up to 10.4MW of IT capacity.
The design is intended to support modular scaling, with AI clusters of up to 10.4MW of IT capacity for greenfield deployments and infrastructure capable of supporting high-density AI workloads in existing facilities.

이 설계는 AMD의 Helios 랙스케일 플랫폼을 기반으로 구축되었으며 최대 246kW의 전력 밀도를 갖춘 AI 랙과 최대 10.4MW의 IT 용량을 갖춘 모듈형, 멀티 클러스터 환경을 지원할 수 있음
이 설계는 그린필드 배포를 위한 최대 10.4MW의 IT 용량을 갖춘 AI 클러스터와 기존 시설의 고밀도 AI 워크로드를 지원할 수 있는 인프라를 통해 모듈식 확장을 지원하기 위한 것임

articles.titleKo: OpenAI의 에이전트는 AI 방어자가 포착하기 전에 Hugging Face를 침해함 · 사용자가 다음에 해야 할 일
articles.summary:
The organization hasn't found any evidence of tampering with public and user-facing models, Spaces, or its software supply chain -- at least, at this stage.
On July 21, OpenAI stated that the rogue agent was one of theirs , and broke out of a sandboxed testing environment to access the internet and pull answers to an evaluation from Hugging Face.
In a security advisory published July 16, Hugging Face said that it detected unauthorized access to a limited set of internal datasets and to several credentials used by the platform's services.

articles.summary:
Also: OpenAI's attack agent did exactly what it was told - just more relentlessly than expected Efforts to guard against fraud in multimedia began in earnest in 2018, when the JPEG committee of IEC and ISO first addressed a growing concern about inauthentic content.
There's a huge financial cost as well: Generative AI could enable fraud losses to reach $40 billion in the US by 2027, up from $12.3 billion in 2023, according to estimates from Deloitte's Center for Financial Services.
International standards bodies are stepping up efforts to help provide the tools that end users and companies need to distinguish real images, videos, and other content from deepfakes and AI-generated slop.

articles.title: One tampered ChatGPT link could spawn a rogue AI agent that took orders from an attacker every five minutes
articles.titleEn: One tampered ChatGPT link could spawn a rogue AI agent that took orders from an attacker every five minutes
articles.titleKo: 변조된 ChatGPT 링크 하나가 5분마다 공격자의 명령을 받는 악성 AI 에이전트를 생성할 수 있음
articles.summary:
A single tampered ChatGPT link could spin up an AI agent that quietly checked the attacker's inbox for new orders every five minutes.
The Agent Builder, introduced in 2025, is available at chatgpt.com/agents/studio/new and accepts two URL parameters. template_name selects a starting template such as "chief-of-staff," while initial_assistant_prompt supplies the instructions.
All they needed was a chatgpt.com link with an attached prompt that looked harmless at first glance.

2025년에 도입된 Agent Builder는 chatgpt.com/agents/studio/new에서 사용할 수 있으며 두 개의 URL 매개변수를 허용함 · template_name은 "Chief of Staff"와 같은 시작 템플릿을 선택하고,initial_assistant_prompt는 지침을 제공함

articles.summary:
Despite more than 300 million people asking ChatGPT health questions each week, risks remain significant: AI chatbots have been shown to give incorrect medical findings with high confidence rather than admitting uncertainty.
OpenAI's early tests also found that more than 70 percent of participants asked health questions outside the dedicated Health section because switching to it was too cumbersome.
Free users receive lower-quality health advice powered by GPT-5.5 Instant, while paying subscribers get access to the stronger GPT-5.6 Sol model.
